title: No choice of what to forage for
old: You picked a focus (Fuel, Food, Medicine, Materials, General), offered only where that category grows, with sub-category hints.
now: The web Forage button is always General. Focus exists only for the CLI and NPCs.
refs: old ForageOverlay.cs:238, ForageFeature.cs:375 · new Verbs.cs:198, Work.cs:504
decision: Restored (2026-11-22): focus Fuel/Food/Medicine/Materials/General, offered only where the category grows, with sub-category hints.

title: No choice of how long to forage
old: You chose 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or Keep Walking (5 minutes, new clues).
now: Foraging is a fixed 60 minutes with a Stop button.
decision: Restored: 15, 30 or 60 minutes (30 by default), and Keep Walking (5 minutes, new clues).

title: Can't read how rich the ground is
old: After the first search you got a quality word (18 of them, such as 'Resources look rich'). Forage was hidden when density fell below 0.4.
now: No quality word. Forage is offered on picked-over ground.
decision: Restored with a change: the quality word shows once the player has foraged the tile; no 0.4 gate, foraging is never refused on sparse ground.

title: No 'N% searched' for hidden finds
old: Each tile showed how much of its hidden finds you had searched, or 'none left'. Also on the tile inspector.
now: Nothing shows it, though the search hours are tracked. Planned in the UI design but not built.
decision: Changed: search effort shown as effort (lightly searched, searched, thoroughly searched) against the terrain's thorough search, never what is left; no N% and no 'none left'. Every forage searches; walking a tile searches at a quarter of the rate.

title: Foraging clues are gone
old: You noticed 0-2 clues (39 texts) weighted by what grows, terrain, weather, time and animals nearby. Clicking a clue set your focus and gave a yield bonus. You said clues may be reworked but the choice must stay: forage what is abundant here, or focus on what you need.
now: None. The catalog says clues must derive from real state, and that is not built.
decision: Restored: the old clues, texts and weighting, read from real state (tags as meant; lying snow for snowy). Fire-damage clue dropped; 'trampled and grazed' weighted by real grazing. Clues apply to NPCs too.

title: Searched-for discovery events leave nothing
old: Searching open ground could turn up 11 discovery events (abandoned camp, frozen traveller, hidden cache, bone scatter, old kill site, water source, beehive, squirrel cache, mushroom patch, deep hole, fish run) plus 10 site events and small-game finds. Each was a choice with loot, fear or a mark.
now: The draw slots still roll but produce nothing. A decision record says authored discoveries keep working until the world produces the same thing. They do not. Abandoned camp survives as a salvage pool.
decision: Partly restored: frozen small game (hare carcass), bone scatter, old kill site, bear's cache, hidden cache (stash), old campsite and squirrel cache (salvage), water source, fire origin (charcoal). The rest wait for design sessions.

title: Finds appear only at the end of a forage
old: Finds were revealed live each minute, colour-coded, with a running total.
now: One list at the end of the session.
decision: Restored: finds appear as you search, with counts; every timed job runs in chunks at the old game's pace and Stop works for all.

title: No warnings before you commit to foraging
old: Before starting you were warned about dark, deep snow, wet ground, whether an axe or shovel would help, and a nearly full pack.
now: No warnings. Excess is dropped afterwards.
decision: Not restored as warnings (decision: the UI shows what the game knows); the facts are the search odds terms.

title: Foraging works freely in the dark
old: Darkness gave a warning and lowered perception, so it cut finds.
now: Foraging in the dark is unrestricted and unpenalised.
decision: Kept the rebuild: perception lowered by darkness (the old formula did not lower it at full night).

title: Scavenge clues and carcass finds are gone
old: A clue could lead to a carcass at some freshness, with a chance of a predator encounter (11 scenarios).
now: None. Catalog marks it replaced but it is not built.
decision: Restored: scavenge clues lay a real carcass at the old freshness; no rolled encounter, real predators find it.

title: Luck never shown
old: A mood line ('You've found a rich patch') told you your luck.
now: Luck is rolled but never shown.
decision: Restored with a change: one luck roll per search; the mood line reads it.

title: Flat forage text
old: Failure lines by quality tier, three-variant discovery text and a Discovery popup.
now: 'You find {name}.'
decision: Restored: failure lines by the band of the ground's real word; 3-variant discovery text; no popup, a rare-toned line.

title: Forage events are gone
old: Unexpected Yield, Beehive Spotted, Rabbit Freeze, Birds Roosting and Fish Visible could interrupt a forage.
now: No event layer. Unexpected Yield was cut; the others are marked replaced but not built.
decision: Not restored (no events, soft rule).

title: Focus bonus changed
old: A focus kept its category whole and other categories came at about 40-60%.
now: Focused finds are doubled 30% of the time (1.3 factor).
decision: Restored: the old filter; FocusGain 1.3 removed.

title: New Foraging skill
old: No forage skill.
now: A Foraging skill adds 1.5% per level.
decision: Kept: the Foraging skill.

title: Day-one tutorial lines gone
old: A day-1 frozen ptarmigan and fuel/tool tutorial lines guided the first forage.
now: None (partly cut in the short-loop plan).
decision: Partly restored: first clue, axe and shovel, and day-one fuel tutorials, once per game. The day-one ptarmigan windfall dropped.

title: Resources are kilograms, not pieces
old: Each resource was a stack of separately weighed pieces: 3 sticks, 2 pine logs of 1.6 and 2.1 kg. Counts showed everywhere. Fuel went on the fire one whole log at a time. Cooking and eating were one piece per action.
now: One kilogram total per resource. A nearly full fire takes part of a log and the rest stays in the pack as a fraction. 'Add pine' is 1 kg and costs a minute per click. Cook and eat work in kilo lumps. Recipes were rewritten in kilos.
refs: old Inventory.cs:128,196, FireHandler.cs:296, HeatSourceFeature.cs:272 · new Items.cs:70, Verbs.cs:70,223, Fire.cs:276

title: Can't choose how many to move
old: You chose how many pieces to move, or Drop 1 / Drop All.
now: Put down and Take move the whole stack. The web page has no amount control.
refs: old TransferOverlay.cs:103, InventoryOverlay.cs:501 · new Verbs.cs:115,183, main.js:457

title: Gear on the ground can never be picked up
old: Tools, clothing and accessories could be moved in and out of storage and off the ground.
now: Stash and unstash handle resources only. A thrown spear, gear that did not fit a full pack and a dead person's kit land on a stash and are lost for good. You can't put gear down either.
refs: old TransferHandler.cs, GroundStashStrategy.cs · new Activity.cs:61, Work.cs:213, Items.cs:199

title: Crafted tools never wear out
old: Crafted tools wore out: hand drill 5 uses, bow drill 15, flint striker 20, pyrite strike-a-light 30, flint knife 15, wooden spear 5, heavy spear 8, stone-tipped 12, stone axe 12. Only found and starting tools were often infinite.
now: Made drills, strikers, flint knives and wooden spears never wear out. Heavy spear lasts 15 and stone-tipped 20. The remake-your-drill loop is gone.
refs: old NeedCraftingSystem.cs:137-640, Gear.cs:191 · new items.json maxDurability -1, Items.cs:104

title: Clothing never wears out
old: Clothing wore down through event outcomes (fall, encounter), losing warmth, so you had to craft replacements.
now: Nothing ever wears worn clothing. Events, the old source of wear, were cut and nothing replaced it.
refs: old OutcomeTemplates.cs:193-230 · new Items.Use callers Combat.cs:794, Fire.cs:556

title: Tents, shovel, pouch and belt can't be had
old: Bone shovel, hide and mammoth tents, small pouch, rope belt and the knives were all craftable or lootable.
now: They exist as gear but no recipe or loot makes them. So snow shelters (need a shovel) and pitching a tent can never happen, though the checklist says Done.
refs: old NeedCraftingSystem.cs:1649, 1356 · new items.json vs recipes.json, loot.json, Verbs.cs:129

title: No stone axe recipe
old: Stone axe: stone, stick and fibre with a knapping stone.
now: An axe comes only from loot. Without one you can't fell trees, so frames, spears and long fires are hard to get.

title: Many tool recipes missing
old: Crude edge, bone knife, shale knife, bone shovel, tinder bundle and flint-and-amadou striker.
now: Missing. Sharp rock and hammerstone stand in. Bone and shale have no use as blades.

title: Mammoth and bear gear can't be made
old: Mammoth hide coat and hood, ivory-tipped spear, mammoth hide pack.
now: Missing. Mammoth hide and ivory have no use. A mammoth kill gives materials with nothing to make from them.

title: Carrying capacity can't be crafted
old: Small pouch, rope belt, proper belt, large bag and mammoth hide pack grew your capacity.
now: Missing. Large bag and proper belt come only from loot.

title: Pack and crafting screens lack descriptions
old: Every resource and gear kind had a one-line description ('Premium tinder. Papery and oily.'), calories per unit, a raw-food warning, a category filter and a recipe description.
now: Names and kilos only. No descriptions anywhere.
refs: old InventoryOverlay.cs:51,467, Gear.cs · new main.js:457, ViewBuilder.cs:244

title: Gear stats and comparisons hidden
old: Weapon damage, uses left, insulation (base and current), waterproofing and capacity bonus were shown. The crafting screen compared an output against gear you own. The body sheet also showed each garment's insulation.
now: Name and condition percent only. You can't compare a stone knife with a flint knife or two garments before choosing.

title: No weapon choice
old: One equipped weapon slot. You chose which to fight with and kept the axe for chopping. A hunt asked which spear to use.
now: No slot. A fight takes the best working weapon in the pack automatically.
refs: old Inventory.cs:181, HuntRunner.cs:30 · new CombatAI.cs:325, Combat.cs:46, Fauna.cs:269

title: Camp storage is any tile, unlimited
old: Camp storage was a 1000 kg cache at camp only, gear included. Natural caches (Ice Crevasse 50 kg, Rock Cleft 40 kg) were predator-safe or weatherproof. Predators ate meat on the ground and in unprotected caches.
now: Any tile's stash is storage, unlimited and unprotected. Only carrion birds raid it. Wolves and bears never touch stashed meat. Cache protection and food preservation are deferred.
refs: old CacheFeature.cs:140-170, PredatorInteraction.cs:70 · new Items.cs:212, Carrion.cs:76
decision: 2026-11-22: restore the old caches (camp 1000 kg; natural caches with capacity, predator-safe or weatherproof) and predators eating exposed food, after design session (1), predators and items.

title: Fire-as-infrastructure: no ember carriers
old: Amadou (8 h) and polypore (12 h) ember carriers were recipes with a Collect Ember button, though the old Collect Ember was a stub that never lit one.
now: Missing.
decision: 2026-11-22: restore, and make it work: carry an ember and light a fire from it with no strike. Deferred to later in the port.

title: Mending and sharpening gone
old: Mend boots, gloves, cap, wrap or leggings with sinew, hide and needle (restores 50%). Sharpen a blade, refit a knife, fit a stone or ivory point, all keeping condition. Equipment events offered field repair.
now: Missing. Only 'fire-harden' and 'stone-tipped' recipes, which consume the item. Moot until clothing wears.
refs: old NeedCraftingSystem.cs:1709, GearCrafting.cs, GameEventRegistry.Equipment.cs · new recipes.json

title: Most recipes now need light
old: Darkness, wet hands and injury only slowed crafting, with a named warning.
now: Most recipes refuse in the dark; fire-hardening and hide drying need a burning fire. Impairment also worsens the odds.
decision: 2026-11-22: restore the old way. Darkness, wet hands and injury slow crafting with a named slowdown shown in the UI, no warning text, never a refusal. Recipes that truly need a fire keep needing one.

title: Recipe inputs reshaped
old: Spear: 3 sticks, or 1 log. Stone tip: a log, any stone and fibre. Strike-a-light: flint and pyrite, no tool.
now: Spear needs 1.5 kg log wood and two steps. Stone tip needs flint and a finished spear. Pyrite striker needs a striking tool. A recipe can take part of a log.
decision: 2026-11-22: design session (2), recipes that make sense. The old recipes are the starting point; inputs counted in discrete pieces.

title: Crafted gear isn't put on at once
old: A crafted garment or weapon was equipped immediately and the old one went to the pack.
now: The result goes into the pack.
decision: 2026-11-22: keep the change. New gear goes into the pack.

title: Camp builds count pieces, items count kilos
old: Camp structures were recipes in the same screen.
now: Camp builds count pieces and item recipes count kilos, side by side in one Make drawer.
decision: 2026-11-22: settled by decision 'Resources are discrete or continuous'.

title: Curing rack replaced by four hours of work
old: A curing rack held 4 items and cured them while you were away: hide 48 h, meat 24 h (dried), berries 12 h, fish 16 h.
now: No rack. 'Dry a hide by the fire' is 4 hours of your own work beside a fire, one hide at a time. Dried meat, fish and berries can't be made.
refs: old CuringRackFeature.cs:38-122, CuringRackHandler.cs · new recipes.json dry_hide
decision: 2026-11-22: restore the old rack (4 items; hide 48 h, meat 24 h, berries 12 h, fish 16 h; cures while away). Design session (3) adds a less effective drying slot at a campfire.

title: Hide scraping yield changed
old: Scraping took one hide piece (a whole animal's hide) to 0.8 kg with no tool.
now: 1.0 kg of hide to 0.8 kg with a cutting tool, so a large hide scrapes into several. One caribou clothes you several times over.
refs: old NeedCraftingSystem.cs:742, CarcassFeature.cs:537 · new recipes.json scrape_hide
decision: 2026-11-22: restore the old way. One whole hide becomes 0.8 kg of scraped hide; one hide is one garment's worth.

title: No tallow or willow bark processing
old: Render fat to tallow (no old use). Process willow bark to plant fibre.
now: Missing. Willow bark can't be turned into fibre.

title: Failed fire strikes cost 1 minute, not 10
old: Each fire-start attempt took 10 minutes whether it caught or not. Three failures at dusk cost 30 minutes.
now: A strike takes 1 minute.

title: No choice of fire tool or tinder
old: The fire screen let you pick the tool and tinder, each with count and bonus.
now: The verb uses the best tool and the first tinder, birch bark first. One Strike button.

title: The opening fire is different
old: One tinder piece per try: the kit's four pinches gave four strikes. A success burned one stick. No kindling meant no attempt.
now: A strike uses a fixed 0.05 kg, so the kit gives three strikes. A success puts on up to 1 kg of kindling, all of the starting sticks. You can strike with tinder alone and waste it on a fire that can't take wood.

title: Firecraft gives +2% a level, not +10%
old: +10% per level, level 1 free on the first try (hand drill and birch bark at level 1 is 70%).
now: +2% per level on a slower curve. The same kit is 62% at level 1.
refs: old FireHandler.cs:136, Skill.cs:11 · new Skills.cs:17, Fire.cs:576
decision: 2026-11-22: keep +2% per level. The playtest's fire death spiral was the player's skill, not the game.

title: Tinder bundle recipe missing
old: Birch bark and amadou made a 3-use fire striker at 90%. Probably an exploit.
now: Missing.
decision: 2026-11-22: restore the birch bark and amadou bundle as a high-quality tinder, not a fire starter. Cap every fire-starting chance at 95%.

title: Mound and stone fire pits unreachable
old: Mound pit (3 h, shovel) and stone pit (5 h, 30 stone and 10 sticks) were camp projects with better wind cover and efficiency.
now: The pit table exists but every fire is an Open pit.

title: Fire sheet lacks read-outs
old: The tend screen showed fuel on versus pit capacity, each fuel's count and weight, a greyed fuel's required temperature, and for embers the minutes left plus 'Add fuel to relight'.
now: Phase, temperature, fuel hours and charcoal only. No room-left read-out, no ember countdown, no piece counts.

title: Torches no longer chain, minutes not shown
old: A guttering torch away from a fire lit a fresh one automatically.
now: The torch dies. You can light the next by hand while the old burns. The page shows no torch minutes.

title: Cooking and eating come in lumps
old: Cook one piece per action (15 min meat, 12 fish) and eat one piece per 10 minutes.
now: One job cooks all your raw meat at 15 min per kg. A meal is max(room in stomach, 500 kcal). You can't take a small bite.
refs: old CookingHandler.cs:71, ConsumptionHandler.cs:218 · new Work.cs:399, Verbs.cs:72,145

title: Overeating becomes fat, not waste
old: Eating past a full stomach wasted the excess, and the food screen warned about it.
now: The excess becomes fat, so gorging before a trip is free. The checklist calls the old behaviour a bug, though the old screen warned on purpose.

title: Eating shows no calories or warnings
old: The food screen showed per item kcal, hydration, '[risk of illness]' on raw food, '[makes you thirsty]' on dried, an 'Eat (risky)' button and bars.
now: Plain 'Eat raw meat' verbs with no numbers or warnings.
refs: old ConsumptionHandler.cs:97, FoodOverlay.cs:112 · new Verbs.cs:113, ViewBuilder.cs:96

title: Wash off blood was cut on a wrong premise
old: Washing took 0.5 L and 5 minutes, removed Bloody and left you slightly wet. A visible button.
now: Missing. Bloody dries on its own, faster by a fire. The decision record says the old game never offered washing, which is false.
decision: 2026-11-22: restore washing (0.5 L, 5 minutes, removes Bloody, leaves you slightly wet). Bloody still dries on its own. Decision record amended.

title: Drink straight from rivers and lakes
old: Drinking used only water in the pack. Rivers were harvestables you collected from.
now: You can drink from any river or lake tile, even frozen, with no pack water.
decision: 2026-11-22: frozen water needs an ice hole or snowmelt, as in the old game. Drinking straight from open, unfrozen water stays.

title: Clothing waterproofing does nothing
old: Every garment's waterproofing (furs 0.1, bear 0.2, mammoth 0.25, hide 0.3) slowed soaking, stopped wind push and trapped sweat.
now: The value is never read. Rain soaks about 10% faster. Waterproofing on mammoth and hide gear is dead data though the checklist says Wetness is Done.

title: Resin waterproofing treatment missing
old: Resin waterproofed worn gear (+0.3), wearing off in rain with warnings.
now: Missing.

title: Sleep gives no fire warning or length choice
old: Sleep asked 1-8 hours and warned 'Your fire will die N hours before you wake' or 'You'll freeze to death in your sleep'.
now: A fixed 8-hour sleep with no prompt or warning. Planned sleep panel not built.

title: Injuries invisible
old: The body panel listed every damaged region and organ with a severity word (Minor to Destroyed) and a bar.
now: No injury list. The sheet shows impaired capacities and blood only, and alerts say 'Moving impaired' without naming the part.

title: Effect and starvation messages flattened
old: Every effect had onset, escalation and ending lines ('Severe hypothermia setting in. You need warmth NOW.'). Starvation narrated 'noticeably thinner' to 'Organ damage imminent'. Severe-stage warnings came before Critical.
now: A generic line on start and end only. Chips show only at Critical.
refs: old EffectFactory.cs, ThresholdWarnings.cs:37, SurvivalProcessor.cs:480 · new Narration.cs:68, ViewBuilder.cs:195

title: No 'why' breakdowns or trends
old: Tooltips showed each capacity change, body deg F per hour, the Wet breakdown (rain, sweat, ground, drying) and the cold breakdown (metabolism, heat loss, evaporation, clothing buffer). Trend arrows sat on every vital.
now: Effects are name and percent only. The Sim has the heat terms but nothing shows them. No trends, no deg F per hour.

title: Clothing buffer and Vitality bars hidden
old: A Vitality bar and a Clothing Warmth bar (the heat buffer) showed on the HUD.
now: Neither shown.

title: Feels-like terms merged
old: Base, Location, Wind, Sun, Precip, Shelter and Fire were separate.
now: Wind, sun and precipitation are one term; torch and bedding are new.

title: Frostbite still leaves a permanent floor
old: Frostbite kept a 5% floor forever.
now: Unchanged, though the decision record names frostbite as the case to fix. A near-death chill leaves Frostbite 5% that no action clears.

title: Infection and fever gone
old: Fever, Inflamed (wound infection), Nauseous, Coughing and the Cold Snap, Wound and Fever arcs. Untreated wounds festered.
now: Missing. A wound has no long tail and no reason to treat it. The design doc keeps the infection plan but it is not built.

title: Sprains and clumsiness gone
old: Falls on hazardous ground added Sprained Ankle (-40% Moving) or Clumsy (-30% Manipulation).
now: Falls do tissue damage only.

title: Fear and other mind effects gone
old: Sore, Stiff, Fear, Shaken and Paranoid marked close calls.
now: Missing. Close calls leave no mark on the body. Fear for people is not built.

title: Honey and teas give no buffs
old: Honey gave Energized. Rose hip tea gave Nourished (+50% healing).
now: Honey is plain calories. Teas are missing.

title: Falls read 'You hurt your left leg'
old: Each travel injury had a matched line ('Your foot catches on a root').
now: One generic line. The accident table says the text is not ported.
refs: old AccidentVariants.cs, TravelHandler.cs:41 · new Narration.cs:79, accidents.json:1

title: Treatment and medicine missing
old: Treat wounds (5 minutes, 20 resource-effect pairs: moss cuts bleeding, willow bark pain, chaga fever) and crafted teas, poultices, bandages and seals.
now: Missing. Ten medicines are foraged and carried but nothing uses them, so Medicine focus is pointless. Bleeding has no counter.

title: Destroyed organs never heal
old: Healing reached every organ below full, even destroyed ones, so a destroyed eye grew back.
now: Destroyed organs (condition 0) never heal. A lost eye or ear is permanent.

title: Incapacitation changed
old: At Moving 0.1 or below every action was blocked and you could only wait.
now: Only walking is refused. Foraging, chopping, butchering and making stay available, only slower.

title: Sleep heals only when fed, watered and warm
old: Sleep healed 6 condition-units per hour with no checks.
now: Sleep heals through the same gates as waking and is scaled by stomach fullness and digestion. The rate is flagged undecided in code.

title: Shelter wind cover also cuts body wind
old: Shelter wind cover reduced only the wind chill on the air.
now: It also cuts convection, wind through clothing and drying, so shelters are warmer. Flagged as an open physics question.

title: Player body differs
old: 75 kg, 15% fat, 30% muscle every run.
now: 68 kg lean frame, 38% muscle, starting fat 15-18% varying per seed.

title: Wait and Rest are 60 minutes, not 5
old: Rest and Wait were a 5-minute wait.
now: 60-minute verbs that run in chunks and can be stopped.

title: Weather front no longer shown
old: The top bar named the front (Storm Front, Calm Before The Storm, Cold Snap, Clear Spell, Warming Period), and a storm warning came ahead of a prolonged blizzard.
now: Not shown anywhere, though the Sim carries it. A storm arrives unannounced. The planned cold-front alert is not built.
refs: old TopBar.cs:34, Weather.cs:584, GameEventRegistry.Weather.cs · new ViewBuilder.cs:171, Sim WeatherSample.Front

title: Night ignores the real sunset
old: Night for work was fixed 21:00-05:00 all year.
now: The same fixed hours, though you decided night should read the weather's real sunset and sunrise. In December the light bar runs to 21:00.

title: Track counts not shown
old: Prints read 'Paw prints x5 - fresh, heading north'. Count and age both mattered.
now: The count is computed but never shown, so a lone wolf and a pack read the same.

title: Desire paths not drawn
old: Paths were drawn on the map by tier, so a Trace showed where herds and you had walked.
now: Not drawn. Trail appears only as a minute bonus in a trip, and the Trace tier does nothing visible.

title: Print reading by exact hour, fixed radius
old: Age by feel (fresh, recent, old, nearly gone). Prints readable within 1 + 3 x Perception tiles.
now: Age to the hour ('3 h ago'). Fixed 3 tiles, so Perception no longer widens it.

title: Discovered finds not on the map
old: Visible tiles showed icons for a found berry bush, spring, flint, prey, a body or traps.
now: Discovered finds never appear on the map and memory keeps no record of them.

title: Named-site first-visit and site events never fire
old: 12 named places queued a first-visit event on arrival (Ancient Grove, Bear Cave, Lookout, Hot Spring...). 26 location events and the Den arc added more.
now: The first-visit data is carried and never read. A decision record says authored discovery content keeps working. Arrivals at the best places are silent.

title: Arrival text easy to miss
old: Arriving somewhere new popped a 'Discovery!' message with the place's name and text.
now: The text sits at the top of the Here drawer, and nothing marks first arrival.

title: Pace asked on every hazardous step
old: One pace decision covered a stretch; walking on reused it unless the risk rose.
now: Every arrow step onto risky ground reopens the trip drawer. The pass is 18 hazardous tiles.

title: Ground in words is gone
old: The tile panel said 'Deep snow, 52 cm', 'Standing water, ankle deep', 'The surface is glazed with ice'.
now: No words. Snow, mud and ice are painted on the map and a trip shows 'Snow and ground +N min'.

title: Snow never buries anything
old: Snow buried carcasses, caches and bushes. A covered target offered only 'Dig up X'. A shovel doubled digging.
now: Nothing is ever buried. A blizzard never hides your kill or stash.

title: Herds ignore snow and mud
old: Herds crossed at full crossing time, slowed by snow and mud like anyone.
now: Herds ignore the ground, so deep snow no longer helps a hunter run down prey.

title: No getting lost in fog
old: Lost in Fog, Lost Your Bearings and Whiteout cost time or turned you around.
now: Travel always lands where you pointed. Fog costs only speed.

title: Precipitation level not shown
old: Precipitation showed as None, Light, Moderate or Heavy.
now: Only the condition name.

title: Terrain names and detail text flattened
old: 'Snowy Plain', 'Frozen Lake', 'Dense Forest'. Details read 'A rotting log, partially buried in snow.'
now: 'plain', 'water', 'forest', 'rock'. 'You find fallen log.'

title: Examine-only land signs gone
old: Bent branches, burrows, lichen rocks and ice formations gave a line of reading the land. A burrow started a fresh trail lead.
now: They leave nothing.

title: Stalk detection risk hidden
old: While stalking, Assess printed 'The caribou is unaware, 22m away. Detection risk: 18%' and the panel showed risk in green, orange or red.
now: Risk is computed but no view shows it. You close in blind.
refs: old CombatOrchestrator.cs:406, CombatPanel.cs:161 · new Combat.cs:1007, ViewBuilder.cs:348

title: Fight narration thin
old: One line per turn: hits graded by weight ('nicks', 'cuts', 'impales') with the body part, misses, dodges, blocks, 'spots you!', 'A wolf attacks!', pack formation.
now: Only 'You hurt your leg.', 'A wolf is hurt.', 'You kill a wolf.' and 'The fight is over'. You can't tell why a round went as it did. The code comment calls it temporary.
refs: old CombatNarrator.cs, CombatScenerio.cs:200 · new Narration.cs:79, combat.js:1

title: Combat panel shows less
old: Target panel: vitality, boldness, threat, injured parts, movement allowance, Unaware or Alert in colour, and each throwable's hit chance.
now: Condition word, state word and weapon. No throw hit chance (the Sim has it), no injuries.

title: Hunting and Fighting skills gone
old: Hunting cut detection 5% a level (5 XP a kill). Fighting added its level to every blow.
now: Hunting skill is hard-coded to 0. Only five skills exist, none of them these.
refs: old CombatFormulas.cs:34, Player.cs:36 · new Combat.cs:581, Skills.cs:3

title: Hunt starts with no search
old: Hunting was a 15 or 30 minute search weighted toward calm herds. No hunting in the dark.
now: A herd on your tile offers Hunt, starting the stalk after one minute. No time cost, no darkness rule.
refs: old HuntStrategy.cs:32, HerdExtensions.cs:62 · new Verbs.cs:208, Fauna.cs:253

title: What the herd is doing is invisible
old: Spotting gave a line by activity ('Head down in the grass, oblivious'), a hint ('Feeding animals are distracted') and Approach or Let it go. Each animal cycled through grazing, moving, resting and alert on a 10-30 minute timer, so waiting could change your odds.
now: The herd's state sets stalk detection but the player never sees it. No approach prompt, no per-animal activity.
refs: old HuntRunner.cs:53, HuntingEncounterVariant.cs:228, Animal.cs:189 · new Fauna.cs:865, ViewBuilder.cs:302

title: The quarry is anonymous
old: 'A large, thin, nervous caribou with a limp': size, condition, nervousness and marks.
now: Size lives only in the body and is never described.

title: Always the weakest animal
old: A random member of a weighted herd.
now: Always the slowest, least alive member. Hunts are easier and always target the same animal.

title: Wounded prey leaves no heading or blood
old: An escaped wounded animal gave 'Bright red arterial spray - you could follow the blood trail' and blood-trail events.
now: 'A wounded caribou gets away.' with no heading, no blood signs, prints only within 3 tiles. About 40% of hunts leave a wounded animal.
refs: old CombatAftermath.cs:107, GameEventRegistry.BloodTrail.cs · new CombatAftermath.cs:62, Narration.cs:95

title: Bears, hyenas and sabre-tooth never attack
old: Bears, cave bears, sabre-tooth and hyenas engaged you, with a den bonus (+0.55). A feeding wolf pack always defended its kill.
now: Only wolves hunt or come for a person. Bear dens, the cave bear and the apex cat are scenery. Homotherium never hunts. Against your rule that predators hunt every person in reach.
refs: old SolitaryPredatorBehavior.cs:61, ScavengerBehavior.cs:120 · new Fauna.cs:550,617, Combat.cs:295

title: Butchering beside a feeding pack is free
old: You couldn't take a kill from feeding predators without a fight.
now: You can butcher beside a feeding pack. The occupied gate exists but is switched off.

title: Packs sense you from 12 tiles
old: Predators found you by sight in range or scent from the next tile (meat, bleeding, Bloody), then searched your last spot for 20 minutes.
now: A hungry pack senses any person within 12 tiles regardless of sight, scent, light, terrain or weather. Against your decision that predators notice what you give off.

title: Escaping a fight may not be an escape
old: After a fight a predator herd waited 30 minutes. A fleeing player moved away.
now: The cooldown is written and never read, and a fleeing player stays on the same tile. A pack may hunt you again next minute. Inferred, not yet tested.
refs: old PackPredatorBehavior.cs:276, CombatScenerio.cs:661 · new Fauna.cs:26,456, CombatAftermath.cs:39

title: Herd events on your tile untold
old: 'The caribou herd bolts north.', 'Wolves bring down a caribou. They begin feeding.', 'The bear retreats.'
now: Nothing. A kill is narrated only if you made it.

title: Smaller predator behaviours gone
old: Hungry wolves chased escaping prey 40% of the time, hyenas shadowed wolf packs and a hunt took up to 3 prey.
now: Packs patrol on, only carcasses draw hyenas, and a hunt goes for one animal.

title: Cooked meat no longer draws wolves
old: Carried cooked meat raised predator boldness.
now: Only raw meat or fish counts.

title: Butchering is one unstoppable click
old: You chose 15 min, 30 min, 1 h or Finish, took what you had, and could come back.
now: One verb runs until done, up to 24 h (a careful bison is about 17 h). The Stop button can't end it.
refs: old ButcherStrategy.cs:63 · new Verbs.cs:211, Work.cs:452, GameHost.cs:132

title: Butcher screen shows no time, condition or warnings
old: The screen showed carcass condition (fresh to spoiled, frozen), yield kg, minutes per mode and warnings (no blade, unsteady hands, frozen). After each session a progress result showed percent and minutes left.
now: Three bare mode verbs. No time, condition, yield or warnings. Full Processing is offered bare-handed. 'You finish butchering' only when done.
refs: old DesktopUi.cs:408, ButcherStrategy.cs:97,231 · new Verbs.cs:211, Narration.cs:92

title: Small game hunting missing
old: Rabbit, ptarmigan and fox as a per-tile density with peak hours, depletion and regrowth. The day 1-3 food loop.
now: Missing. Rabbit and Fox species rows exist unused. The only meat is big game you can barely hunt (about 2% kills).
refs: old SmallGameFeature.cs, HuntStrategy.cs:91 · new SiteSmallGame (data only)

title: Snares missing
old: Snare lines with bait, passive catches, stolen or destroyed states and durability. The reason to head out each morning.
now: Missing, no snare gear or recipe.

title: Fishing, ice holes and nets missing
old: Rod fishing through ice holes you cut (5-45 min, refreezing in about 10 h), and nets with catch, loss and theft.
now: Missing. A frozen lake gives water without a hole.
refs: old FishingStrategy.cs, IceCuttingStrategy.cs, SetNetStrategy.cs · new none
decision: 2026-11-22, drinking only: frozen water needs an ice hole or snowmelt (see FIR-13). Fishing and nets not yet decided.

title: Birds have no body, feathers have no source
old: Ptarmigan were bodies that gave feathers when butchered.
now: Cut: 'Birds have no body plan'. The plan cited for this cannot be found.

title: Shove formula changed
old: Shove success 50% x strength ratio x weight ratio.
now: 50% x weight x speed ratio, capped, halved against a set stance.

title: No permadeath or autosave
old: Autosave every 2 minutes. Death or the crossing deleted the save, so a run was final.
now: Manual single-slot save. The death screen offers 'Load your save'. A closed tab loses the run and a quick crossing can be save-scummed.

title: Reload starts a new world
old: The game resumed your save on launch. 'Start a new game?' asked to confirm.
now: Every page load is a fresh world, seed 1 unless ?seed= is given. New game has no confirm.

title: No people in the valley
old: A starting companion nearby, 3-4 bands of survivors with camps, Come with me and dismiss, giving and asking for supplies, relationship memory shown as lines, deaths and bodies found with decay text, looting and burying, a people screen, and NPCs on the map.
now: None. No NPC is placed in any game, though the NPC mind is rewritten in the Sim and runs in tests. Planned as roadmap item 12.
refs: old NPCFactory.cs, CompanionInteractions.cs, NPCOverlay.cs · new World.cs:66, Npc.cs

title: NPC personality and tool-making gone
old: Sociability, Selfishness and Boldness shown and used. NPCs crafted their own axe and fire starter.
now: No personality. NPCs spawn with an axe and knife and cannot make a fire starter.

title: Camp can't move
old: 'Make camp' anywhere: bedding and a camp cache placed and the camp moved there.
now: Camp is always the generated camp. The map marker, place flag and 'While you were away' receipt read only it. Moving camp toward the pass is not recognised.

title: No shelter upgrade by rebuilding
old: Rebuild a branch frame into a log frame, salvaging 60%.
now: Missing.

title: Camp hazards gone
old: Vermin raids, shelter groans in wind or snow, choking smoke, scattering embers and burns.
now: Only snow-shelter melt damages a shelter. Camp is safe from everything but predators and cold.

title: Den arc gone
old: Find a den, assess the claim, confront or evict the occupant, then clear it, move in or relocate camp.
now: None.

title: Signs never shown
old: The design promised signs that carry a cause.
now: Signs exist in the Sim but only the dev report reads them. No ravens over a pack, no grazed or picked ground, no bones on screen.

title: Predator chip says where, not what it's doing
old: A Threats block showed each predator with what it was doing ('last seen hunting'), where and how long ago.
now: One chip for the nearest predator within 6 tiles: name, count and age. Not what it was doing.

title: Opening goal never stated
old: 'A Break in the Clouds': the pass is visible, your people are beyond it. 'First: survive. Then: prepare. Then: climb.'
now: One journal line, seen only if you open the journal.

title: Journal not saved, shorter
old: A 200-entry log, saved with the game and always on screen.
now: A journal drawer: 80 lines kept, 40 shown, not saved, cleared to 'Loaded.' after a load. Quick actions appear nowhere else.

title: No discovery log
old: The Land, Beasts, Provisions, Medicine and Works, each 'N discovered' then 'N / ~M'. 'New discovery' lines. Recipes unlocked as you found materials, and each food eaten was logged.
now: None. Every recipe is listed from the start, with no unlock moment on finding flint.

title: Place sheet shows far less
old: The tile inspector showed ground in words, shelter insulation and wind block, forage or 'depleted', hidden finds searched, game, water, traps, curing rack, carcass decay stage, cache kg, bedding quality and NPCs, live on any tile in sight. Bedding showed as a feature.
now: The Here drawer shows story, fire, feature verbs and exits. Other tiles show only what memory notes. Missing shelter numbers, bedding, depletion, carcass freshness.

title: No low-fire warning
old: Warnings every action: 'Fire burning low - N remaining', 'Your fire will die in N minutes!'
now: No fire alert. The dock shows fuel hours only when you stand at the fire. The planned night-no-fuel alert is not built.
decision: 2026-11-22: the night-no-fuel alert becomes a fact on the fire panel ('burns about 3 h · dawn in 9 h'), not a warning (decision 'The UI shows what the game knows').

title: Injuries on a walk go unseen
old: Travel injuries and quick results printed to the always-visible log.
now: A walk's lines go only to the journal. An injury on arrival shows only as an alert chip if a capacity drops below 90%.

title: No work length choice, Stop does nothing
old: Chop 30 min, 1 h, 1.5 h, 2 h, finish the tree, or cancel. Forage by chosen time.
now: Fixed budgets: chop, harvest and salvage up to 4 h. These run as one step, so the Stop button does nothing on them (also forage, cook, butcher).

title: No UI scale, music or mute
old: A UI scale setting, music and mute.
now: None. The browser zooms.
